en: Mm... You woke me. Not many challengers make it this far before I've had my rest.
I am Caitlin of the Elite Four. My Psychic-type Pokémon are waiting. Let me see what you're made of.
You've returned. How delightful. Let us see how much you have grown.
Splendid. Your Pokémon fought with grace, and you guided them with a clear mind.
A light began to glow in the corner of the room.
I shall return to my rest now. Do go on. The Champion awaits.
The light carried {player} back down to the hall.
